title: Sheriff's Office Honors Retired Officers and Veterans at Breakfast Forum
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff's Office hosted a Retired Law Enforcement Breakfast Forum on Nov. 13, bringing retired officers and local veterans together to reconnect and be recognized for a lifetime of service.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office hosted a Retired Law Enforcement Breakfast Forum on Thursday, Nov. 13, bringing together retired law enforcement professionals and local veterans to reconnect, reminisce, and celebrate a lifetime of service.

The morning was filled with fellowship and conversation, and a chance to recognize the men and women who dedicated their careers to protecting and serving the community.

"Retirement may mark the end of a career, but it never takes away the honor, pride, and legacy of serving in law enforcement," Sheriff Martin Cuellar said. "Those who dedicated their lives to protecting our community will always be part of our law enforcement family. We are forever grateful for their sacrifices, commitment, and years of service."

Sheriff Cuellar and the Sheriff's Office thanked all retired law enforcement professionals for their years of service and for remaining part of the law enforcement family.

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office (Facebook), Nov. 13, 2026.
